name: Oberhaching square enclosures
published: The Bavarian State Office for Monument Protection lists Late Iron Age square enclosures (Viereckschanzen) here: one to the west and a double enclosure to the east. The key counts those three enclosures; other ground monuments in the box are not in it.

sources.cite: Bayerisches Landesamt für Denkmalpflege, Bayerischer Denkmal-Atlas, ground monuments D-1-7935-0042 and D-1-7935-0043
Schwarz, K. (1959) Atlas der spätkeltischen Viereckschanzen Bayerns. Munich: Bayerisches Landesamt für Denkmalpflege.

features.note: Mapped as a point; a Viereckschanze is usually 80 to 120 m across, so 110 m is assumed.
